title: Past tense: preterite versus perfect
summary: Use preterite for completed events in a finished past time frame and perfect for past events connected to the present.

blocks.text: Use preterite for completed events in a finished past time frame and perfect for past events connected to the present.

items: Jeg har jobbet med Power BI i flere år.
Specific finished time expressions often favor preterite.
The exact choice depends on discourse context, not only grammar labels.
